recording.participants: Left: exact selected edited BU checkpoint and recipe/source hashes. Right: current assistant through authenticated manual action channel. Record the assistant model identifier only if supplied by trusted runtime metadata; do not assume an unverified Astra identifier or price.
recording.truthfulness: No replayed actions, scripted solution, simulated success, hidden state edits or fabricated cursor movement. Preserve1x raw video and event timing. Labels and elapsed timers sit outside the game frames. Any later trimmed presentation must retain the full raw recording and disclose cuts/speed changes.
recording.artifact_bounds: One finalized WebM at most256MiB plus bounded JSONL events and a manifest; hashes, actual dimensions, duration and source/call IDs recorded. If finalization or transfer fails, retain the failure and do not claim video availability. Retrieve only this demo's exact artifact paths once under a separately checked disk/transport budget.

frozen_demo_protocol.native_game_timers: Never altered;90s is an additional harness stop limit. Both ready frames begin the level on the same harness start signal. Model thinking, manual channel delay, rendering and action latency count in wall time.
frozen_demo_protocol.model_bounds: At most48 BU scored requests plus one neutral unscored warmup;192 output tokens/request and64 warmup tokens. BU async wait40s with independent45s native-owner watchdog. One pending request only; unknown inference disposition aborts the demo.
frozen_demo_protocol.channel_bounds: At most one outstanding observation/action per actor;30s action-response timeout included in the level wall. No retry after unknown command delivery. Strict level/session/sequence/observation-hash match and at-most-once action consumption.
frozen_demo_protocol.global_bounds: Proposed child900s, remote960s, startup240s; fixed once-only invocation and host total deadline. Freeze after actual cost reconciliation, not permission to spend beyond the existing30USD ceiling.
frozen_demo_protocol.pairing: UNPAIRED qualitative live demonstration: inspected official embed documentation has no deterministic seed/reset API. The same level number is not proof of an identical randomized puzzle. Retain both initial screenshot hashes without using mismatch to retry or choose a nicer run.
frozen_demo_protocol.score: Accept captcha-completed only from event.origin exactly https://embed.neal.fun and event.source exactly the current actor iframe.contentWindow, with current level/session binding. Done text is only a model claim. Missing/late completion, action limit, invalid action, timeout and transport failure remain explicit outcomes.
frozen_demo_protocol.claims: Report success by level, wall time, actual BU tokens/calls and measured compute costs. This four-level unpaired demo cannot establish SOTA,10x superiority or general computer-use capability. Manual bridge latency remains part of end-to-end assistant timing and is separately disclosed.

shared_policy_surface.observation: Each actor receives ONLY its own iframe screenshot at465x600, its own bounded visible DOM/AX state and truthful prior action feedback. No other actor's pane, hidden attributes, page source, game variables, answer maps, cross-actor history or scorer internals.
shared_policy_surface.schema: Browser Use0.12.9 native envelope with1..8 actions, bounded by remaining12. click accepts either current visible element index OR iframe-local coordinate_x/coordinate_y; input accepts current input index,text,clear; scroll accepts down,pages capped at1; send_keys limited to Enter,Tab,Escape,Space,Backspace and arrows; done is a claim. No navigation, downloads, file actions, browser shortcuts, code, arbitrary selectors or tool calls.
shared_policy_surface.executor: Trusted adapter maps indexes to current actor-owned ElementHandles and local coordinates to that iframe rectangle. Validate whole proposed batch before dispatch; fresh visibility/identity checks precede each queued action. Input clear=true uses actual replacement semantics, never append. All physical mouse/keyboard actions serialize under one lock and verify target-frame focus to prevent cross-pane interference.
shared_policy_surface.unsupported_controls: No drag tool is invented beyond the pinned native action schema. If a frozen level requires unsupported controls, report that protocol limitation rather than silently add a new action after model outcomes. CPU-only reference interaction/preflight can identify interface defects before the scored protocol freeze.
shared_policy_surface.network: Only exact official public embed URLs for frozen levels may be navigated. A CPU browser preflight records required public asset origins; freeze a minimal browser request allowlist before model execution. Block unrelated navigation, popup pages and downloads. Use no personal cookies, accounts or sessions.

minimal_modules.neal_protocol.py: Typed Observation, ActionEnvelope, ActionResult and TerminalReceipt; shared action validation, fresh index map, completion-origin/source checks and one-shot sequence state.
minimal_modules.neal_browser.py: Owned two-iframe page, fixed video dimensions, visible-only observation capture, serialized actions and finalization. No model/provider code.
minimal_modules.neal_demo.py: One supervised CUDA/browser child; fixed BU recipe; concurrent actor loops using the same observation/executor; independent CPU supervisor with local progress/watchdog. SDK queue I/O must run in an isolated broker path so it cannot block the native-owner watchdog.
minimal_modules.neal_bridge.py: Tiny local Modal-SDK client for next_observation and submit_action; no browser driver. The active assistant uses existing exec tools to call this bridge and displays the returned PNG, then submits one validated native action envelope.

apis.start_demo: start_demo(admission, observation_queue_id, action_queue_id) -> exact FunctionCall handle; one invocation after CPU/video preflight and budget admission
apis.submit_action: submit_action({session_id,actor,level,seq,observation_sha256,native_action_json}) -> delivery receipt only; actual execution and completion require subsequent matching ActionResult/TerminalReceipt
apis.action_result: {session_id,actor,level,seq,accepted,executed,action_error,started_monotonic,returned_monotonic}; missing receipt never means success or no effect
apis.terminal_receipt: {actor,level,reason,trusted_completion_received,completion_monotonic,elapsed_s,actions,policy_calls,tokens,initial_screenshot_sha256}; game completion proof and model claims separate
apis.queue_transport: Authenticated Modal Queue partitions scoped to this session/actor. Queue.from_id allows the bridge to attach by returned ID. Use bounded get/put timeouts, never clear/retry unknown commands. Each JSON message<896KiB, PNG<=512KiB before base64 and visible DOM<=64KiB; queue transport is not durable evidence storage.
apis.artifacts: finalize_report() -> source-bound JSON manifest and exact owned WebM path/hash after context close return. Private SDK retrieval only, no public endpoint required.

tool_and_cua_boundary: The bridge operates only a new, user-authorized remote benchmark browser in Modal. It does not control the user's local Chrome or native apps, and does not replace or circumvent cua_repl for those surfaces. The assistant can receive actual screenshot bytes via an existing tool response/image display and choose typed actions through the reviewed SDK bridge. If execution is moved onto the user's computer/browser, use cua_repl's documented APIs and re-evaluate recording capabilities there; do not use the remote bridge as a local-browser backdoor.
